card.name: Inside the word disease or disorder
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the middle piece of a long or capitalized word that is about to finish as "disease" or "disorder", such as the "ISE" in D-ISE-ASE. It is mostly seen in all-caps warning headings and condition names.

modes.label: Capitalized DISEASE
modes.description: The "ISE" piece in a split-up all-caps DISEASE, in warning headings or condition lists.
modes.example: WARNING: INTERSTITIAL LUNG D<<ISE>>ASE and EMBRYO-FET

modes.label: Other disease-ending words
modes.description: A piece just before a word that completes "disorder" or "disease", as in lymphoproliferative disorder, airway disease, or an abbreviated journal title.
modes.example: WARNING: POST-TRANSPLANT LYMPHOPROLIFER<<ATIVE>> DISORDER, OTHER MALIGNANCIES

card.writes: It pushes the model toward disease words (disease, diseases, and the Chinese terms for disease).
card.plain: It lights up when a disease name is partway through being written and the word "disease" is about to finish.
